newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following major business stories on December 25:

WASHINGTON - President Clinton is debating whether to use an expected budget bonus to avoid deeper cuts in Medicare spending, soften trims for other programs or give the middle class a slightly larger tax break.
NEW YORK - The stock market sent investors home for Christmas on a happy note, thanks to a rebound in bellwether technology shares.
WASHINGTON - Teamster drivers prepared for a brief Christmas break in their strike against Giant Foods Inc. as the walkout entered its 10th day with no end in sight.
WASHINGTON - The Federal Communications Commission ignites a battle between local and long distance telephone carriers over billions in access fees.
